blogs.title: Instant Poha cereal Powder Recipe, Protein powder for Babies
blogs.title_hi: झटपट पोहा अनाज पाउडर पकाने की विधि, शिशुओं के लिए प्रोटीन पाउडर
blogs.content:
Healthy and homemade poha cereal for your babies which is high in protein and carb. It helps in weight gaining in babies.

 

This recipe is a healthy protein cereal mix for baby. It has poha and roasted gram dal which helps in weight gaining in babies. Poha cereal is rich in protein and carb. You can feed this to babies above 7 months.

 

Poha Cereal Powder - Poha & Gram Dal Health Mix Powder - Protein Powder for Babies

 

Prep time

5 mins

 

Cook time

10 mins

 

Total time

15 mins

 

 

Recipe type: Baby Food

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 1.5 cup

 

Ingredients

For Cereal Powder:

Red Rice Poha / Aval - 1 cup

Roasted Gram Dal / Pottu Kadalai - ½ cup

 

For Porridge:

Poha Cereal Powder - 2 tablespoon

Water - ½ cup

Salt to taste

Ghee - 1 tsp

 

Instructions

Take poha in a dry pan and roast till golden. Take it in a blender.

Roast gram dal till golden. Add it to a blender.

Powder fine.

Store in an airtight container.

Now make the porridge, take some powder in a saucepan, add water and cook till it thickens.

Add salt and ghee and mix well.

Feed your baby.

blogs.content:
Puffed Rice Instant Cereal for Babies. Highly Nutritious and Protein-rich porridge mix for babies. This is an instant cereal recipe which is great for travel too.

This recipe is a healthy protein cereal mix for baby. It has puffed rice and roasted gram dal which helps in weight gaining in babies. Puffed rice cereal is rich in protein and carb. You can feed this to babies above 6 months.

 

Puffed Rice Instant Cereal for Babies

 

Prep time

5 mins

 

Total time

5 mins

 

Serves: 1 cup

 

Ingredients

FOR INSTANT CEREAL:

Puffed Rice - 1.5 cup

Roasted Gram Dal (Pori Kadalai) - ½ cup

 

FOR MAKING PORRIDGE:

Puffed Rice Cereal Mix - ¼ cup

Hot Water - ¼ cup or as needed

Roasted Cumin Powder & Salt to taste

or

Jaggery Syrup or any sweetner to taste

 

Instructions

Take both ingredients in a blender and powder fine. Store in a container.

For making porridge, take the mix in a bowl, add hot water, cumin powder and salt and mix well. You can add sweetner to make a sweet porridge too.

Feed your baby.

blogs.title: Sago and Urad Dal Cereal Recipe for Babies - Urad Dal Porridge for babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए साबूदाना और उड़द दाल अनाज पकाने की विधि - शिशुओं के लिए उड़द दाल दलिया
blogs.content:
Nutritious and protein-rich homemade healthy mix for your babies. This baby food is excellent for weight gain in babies.

This recipe is a healthy protein cereal mix for baby. It has sago and urad dal which helps in weight gaining in babies. Urad dal is high in protein and sago has carbohydrates that are good for babies. You can feed this to babies above 7 months.

 

Sago Urad Dal Cereal for Babies

 Prep time

10 mins

 

Cook time

10 mins

 

Total time

20 mins

 

Recipe type: Baby Food

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 1 cup

 

Ingredients

Whole Urad dal - ½ cup

Sago / Sabudana - ½ cup

 

FOR MAKING PORRIDGE:

Sago Urad dal Mix - 1 tablespoon

blogs.title: Cauliflower Puree Recipe for babies - Cauliflower mash for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए फूलगोभी प्यूरी पकाने की विधि - शिशुओं के लिए फूलगोभी मैश
blogs.content:
Healthy cauliflower puree which is very nutritious for your baby. It has lots of vitamins in them which makes it even more healthy.

Cauliflower is packed full of phytochemicals which are said to help prevent cancer. Just one cup of cauliflower is packed with Vitamin A, Vitamin C, and even calcium. Cauliflower is a great addition to a healthy diet but it causes many people to be a bit gassy.

Cauliflower is a little gassy vegetable, so you have to introduce it to babies after 8 months.

Cauliflower Puree for babies - Cauliflower Mash for Babies

 

Prep time

5 mins

 

Cook time

5 mins

 

Total time

10 mins

 

Recipe type: Baby Food

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 1 cup

 

Ingredients

Cauliflower florets - 1 cup

Water - ¼ cup

 

Instructions

Take clean cauliflower in a saucepan. Add a splash of water and cook covered till tender.

Take it in a blender and puree till smooth.

Pour this in a bowl and feed your baby.

 

Notes

1)You can introduce this to your baby after 8 months.

2)You can add a pinch of salt to your puree for better taste.

blogs.title: Sooji Cereal mix Recipe for Babies - Instant Rava  Porridge mix powder for Babies
blogs.title_hi: सूजी अनाज मिश्रण पकाने की विधि शिशुओं के लिए - शिशुओं के लिए तुरंत रवा दलिया मिश्रण पाउडर
blogs.content:
Healthy and nutritious sooji porridge mix for babies. It is rich in the carb, protein, and fat which makes a great breakfast for babies.

 

Sooji Cereal Mix for Babies

 

Prep time

10 mins

 

Cook time

15 mins

 

Total time

25 mins

 

Recipe type: Baby Food

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 cups of powder

 

Ingredients

Sooji / Semolina / Rava - 1 cup

Roasted Gram Dal / Pori Kadalai - ½ cup

Cashews - ¼ cup

Cardamom Powder - 1 teaspoon

 

FOR PORRIDGE:

Sooji powder - 2 tablespoon

Water - ½ cup or as needed

Sweetener as needed

 

Instructions

Roast sooji and cool it down.

Roast gram dal and cashews till golden and remove to a bowl and cool it down.

Take it in a blender, add cardamom and powder finely.

Store in an airtight container.

While making porridge, add some powder in a saucepan. add water and cook till thickened.

Add sweetener and mix well.

feed your baby.

 

Notes

1)This can be started after 7 months in babies.

2)Store this in the fridge for a month.

blogs.title: Beetroot Puree Recipe for Babies - How to make beet puree for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए चुकंदर प्यूरी रेसिपी - शिशुओं के लिए चुकंदर प्यूरी कैसे बनाएं
blogs.content:
Healthy beetroot puree which is so good for babies. This is a simple puree which can be mixed with rice porridge or any other porridges too.

For a variation, I made beetroot puree as well. So it is more healthy and nutritious. Beetroots have not only the amazing color, but it is also rich in antioxidants, folate, manganese, potassium, vitamin A and many other properties. So it is good for your babies.

 

Things to remember:

1)The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth.

2)Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3)I don’t prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day. But if you are busy or find difficult to get time, then freeze it in individual containers and thaw it overnight in the fridge.

4)After having this puree, your baby's poop will be red in color. Don’t panic seeing that, it is because of the beets.

 

Beetroot Puree for Babies

 

Preparation time

5 mins

 

Cook time

10 mins

 

Total time

15 mins

 

Recipe type: Baby Food

Cuisine: Indian

 

Ingredients

Beetroot - 1 peeled and grated

 

Instructions

Take it in a saucepan, cover with little water and cook for 5 to 6 mins.

Cool it down. Take it in a blender and puree till smooth.

Pour in a sterilized bowl and feed.

blogs.title: Wheat Peanut Health mix powder Recipe for Babies - Peanut Porridge Powder
blogs.title_hi: गेहूं मूंगफली स्वास्थ्य मिश्रण पाउडर शिशुओं के लिए पकाने की विधि - मूंगफली दलिया पाउडर
blogs.content:
Healthy nutritious peanut wheat powder which is very good for weight gaining in babies. You can start giving this powder after 8 months.

Peanuts have so many health benefits in them.

 

1)Good for physical development

2)Ideal for brain development.

3)It has lots of vitamins and minerals.

4)Good source of antioxidants.

 

You can start this powder for babies above 8 months. 

 

Wheat Peanut Health Mix for Babies

 

Preparation time

10 mins

 

Cook time

15 mins

 

Total time

25 mins

 

Recipe type: Baby Food

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 cups

 

Ingredients

FOR WHEAT POWDER:

Wheat Rava - 1 cup

Green Gram - ½ cup

Peanuts - ¼ cup

 

FOR MAKING PORRIDGE:

Wheat Powder - 3 tablespoon

Water - 1 cup

Salt to taste

Ghee to taste

 

Instructions

Take wheat rava in a dry pan and roast till golden. Remove to a plate.

Take green gram in a dry pan and roast till golden. Remove to a plate.

Cool it down.

Powder it finely. Remove to a bowl.

Now take peanuts in a pan, roast till golden.

Take peanuts in a blender and powder lightly. Don't over grind else it will get pasty,

Add this to the broken wheat and mix well.

Store in an airtight container in the fridge.

For making porridge, take powder and water in a saucepan and cook till it thickens and cooked.

Add salt and ghee and mix well.

Serve.

blogs.title: Mixed Dal and Rice Porridge Mix Recipe For Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए मिश्रित दाल और चावल का दलिया मिक्स रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Mixed dal and rice porridge mix for babies which is very healthy for them. This is a great porridge for weight gain, you can feed babies this for lunch.

This healthy dal rice porridge mix is a great way to feed babies dal and rice. This protein-rich health powder is a 

You can start this powder for babies above 8 months. 

 

Mixed Dal & Rice Porridge Mix for Babies

 

Preparation time

10 mins

 

Cook time

15 mins

 

Total time

25 mins

 

Recipe type: Baby Food

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2.5 cups

 

Ingredients

FOR HEALTH MIX POWDER:

Rice - 1.5 cup

Masoor Dal - ¼ cup

Moong Dal - ¼ cup

Green Gram - ¼ cup

Roasted Gram Dal - ¼ cup

Toor Dal - ¼ cup

 

FOR PORRIDGE:

Health Mix powder - 3 tablespoon

Water - 1 cup

Cumin Powder - ½ tsp

Asafoetida / Hing / Kaya Podi a pinch

Garlic - 1 clove grated

Ghee - 1 tsp

Salt to taste

Instructions

Take all dals in a sieve and wash well. dry completely.

Take rice in a sieve and wash well. Dry completely.

Take dals in a pan and rice in another pan and roast on medium heat till roasted.

Remove to a bowl and cool completely.

Powder fine. Store in an airtight container.

For making porridge. Take powder in a saucepan, add water, garlic, cumin powder, asafoetida and cook on low heat for 5 to 7 mins till done.

Now remove to a bowl, add salt and ghee and mix well.

Serve.

blogs.title: Masoor Dal Soup powder for Babies, Instant Dal Soup for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए मसूर दाल सूप पाउडर, शिशुओं के लिए तुरंत दाल सूप
blogs.content:
Healthy and protein-rich masoor dal soup powder for babies. This is the best way to feed dal to your baby in an instant and takes less than 5 mins to make.

Mahima loves dal soup. But it really pains to cook it in a pressure cooker then puree it. So many pots and pans to wash. So I made this instant soup powder which comes handy. Also, it can be mixed with cooked rice and ghee which makes a great lunch for babies.

 

Masoor Dal Soup Powder for Babies

 

Preparation time

10 mins

 

Cook time

5 mins

 

Total time

15 mins

 

Recipe type: Soup

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 1 cup

 

Ingredients

SOUP POWDER RECIPE:

Masoor Dal - 1 cup

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakan - 1 tsp

Asafoetida / Hing / Kaya Podi - ½ tsp

Turmeric Powder - 1 tsp

 

SOUP RECIPE:

Masoor Dal Powder - 1 tablespoon

Water - ½ cup

Salt to taste

 

Instructions

Wash and drain dal well.

Take masoor dal in a dry pan and roast till golden.

Take it in a blender. Dry roast cumin seeds, turmeric, and asafoetida.

Add it to the blender and blend till fine.

Store in an airtight container.

When making, take powder and water in a saucepan and cook till thick.

Add salt and mix well.

Cool and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Kokkattan Recipe, Rice & Palm Jaggery finger food for Babies
blogs.title_hi: कोक्कट्टन पकाने की विधि, शिशुओं के लिए चावल और पाम गुड़ की उंगली भोजन
blogs.content:
Kokkattan Recipe – Rice & Palm Jaggery Finger Food For Babies with step wise pictures.

Best finger food for babies, this rice and palm jaggery fingers are so easy to make and are very nutritious for your babies. This is rich in carb and iron.

I was waiting for a long time to share this recipe. This is traditional finger food for babies. It is nutritious and easy to make for your kids. Since it is shaped in a long shape, it is easy for your baby or toddler to hold in their tiny hands. The sweetness is from palm jaggery which is very good for babies.

This snack is high in carb and iron.

 

Kokkattan Recipe - Rice & Palm Jaggery Finger Food For Babies

 

Preparation time

10 mins

 

Cook time

30 mins

 

Total time

40 mins

 

Recipe type: Baby Food

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 12 to 15 pieces

 

Ingredients

Rice - 1 cup

Palm Jaggery - 1 cup

Water - ½ cup

Cardamom Powder - ½ tsp

Dry Ginger Powder - ½ tsp

 

Instructions

Take rice and wash it well. Drain completely.

Take it in a dry pan and roast on low heat till golden and puffed. Take it in a blender, add cardamom and ginger powder and powder fine. Set aside on a large plate.

Take palm jaggery, water in a saucepan and boil till jaggery melts. Strain to a pan.

Now cook this till the syrup thickens it till take around 6 to 10 mins. Drop a spoonful of syrup in a bowl of cold water. the syrup will stay as it is without melting and you will be able to form a hardball.

Now Take the syrup off the heat, add the syrup little by little in a small amount of the rice flour. Mix well and shape it into a long shape.

Set aside. It will harden as it cools.

Once cooled store in an airtight container.

Notes

1)Don't add syrup all at once. Just add little syrup to a small portion of the rice flour and mix. Then shape it. 

2)If you add all at once it will harden and you won't be able to take shape.

blogs.title: Spinach Puree Recipe for Babies, Spinach Sauce for Babies
blogs.title_hi: पालक प्यूरी पकाने की विधि शिशुओं के लिए, पालक सॉस बच्चों के लिए
blogs.content:
Healthy spinach puree to have on hand. You can add this to literally anything. A great way to feed kids and babies spinach.

Spinach puree is a healthy way to include spinach in your kid's diet. It is very recently I discovered this method. What I do is, as soon as I buy a bunch of spinach. I Clean them well in several changes of water. Drain them and cook them down. I then puree them and store them in the fridge. They stay good for 5 to 7 days. I use them throughout the week. I add them to dosa batter, chapati batter, curries.

I add this to dosa batter mainly and feed my 1-year daughter daily morning. She seems to love it.

 

Spinach Puree for Babies

 

Preparation  time

5 mins

 

Cook time

5 mins

 

Total time

10 mins

 

Recipe type: Baby Food

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 1.5 cups

 

Ingredients

Spinach / Palak - 3 cups

Water - ¼ cup

 

Instructions

Take spinach and wash well.

Take it in a saucepan, add water and cook for 5 mins.

Cool it and grind it to a smooth paste.

Store it in an airtight container in the fridge for 3 to 4 days.

You can add this to dosa batter, chapati flour or mix with rice along with salt and ghee.

Beetroot & Carrot Khichdi for Babies

5 mins

 

Cook time

10 mins

15 mins

Take all ingredients except salt and ghee in a saucepan and cook till the powder is cooked and the porridge is thick.

Add salt and ghee and mix well.

Spoon it into serving bowl and feed.

blogs.title: Beetroot milk Recipe, Rose milk using Beetroots
blogs.title_hi: चुकंदर का दूध पकाने की विधि, चुकंदर का उपयोग करके गुलाब का दूध
blogs.content:
Delicious rose milk made using beetroots. This is healthy for kids and toddlers. Instead of giving normal rose milk with lots of food coloring, you can give this beet milk.

Maha loves rose milk. But the rose milk extract which is available in supermarkets is so high in food color which is not good for kids. So I created this beet milk which tastes exactly like rose milk plus it is healthy for your kids.

 

Beetroot Milk Recipe - Rose Milk Using Beetroots

 

Preparation time

10 mins

 

Cook time

15 mins

 

Total time

25 mins

 

Recipe type: Beverages

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 1 cup syrup

Ingredients

Beetroot - 2 large peeled and chopped

Sugar - 1 cup

Rose Extract - 1 tsp

Water - 1 cup

 

Instructions

Take beetroots and water in a blender and puree till smooth. Strain the juice.

Now take it in a saucepan, add sugar and boil for 5 to 6 mins.

Now take it off the heat and add in the rose extract.

Store in a container in the fridge.

Mix with milk and enjoy.
